sentences.text: Succinctly, the brief material facts to decide the instant revision petition are that Ms. Manju Yadav (deceased) daughter of Sh. Om Prakash was married to Prem Kumar in the year 1997 in accordance with the Hindu Rites and Rituals.
After the marriage, the husband of Manju Yadav and his family members alleged to have started to harass and torture her for demand of dowry.

That,
unfortunately, on 01.10.2013, the said Manju Yadav committed suicide by hanging herself to the ceiling fan.
There are two sons from the wedlock of Ms. Manju Yadav and Prem Kumar of the age of 14 years and 12 years at the time of the alleged incident.

That, no complaint was made by the father of the deceased on the day of the incident and Sh. Om Prakash Yadav, father of the deceased made a written complaint after 12 days of the incident i.e. 12.10.2013 and made the allegation against Prem Kumar and his family members.
Investigation was carried out and during the course of the investigation, a suicide note of dated 05.10.2013 received in the Police Station by Post.
The same was sent for the FSL result.
The FSL result has been received by the IO and as per the FSL result, the signature of the deceased does not match with the signature made on the said suicide note.

3. That, perusal of the chargesheet, it reveals that on dated 11.08.2017, the father and brother of the deceased handed over a handwritten letter to the IO and stated that because of some misunderstanding, they made the complaint against the husband of their daughter and his family members.
Their daughter was patient of depression and there was no atrocity or maltreatment with the deceased by her husband or his family members.
She was the patient of depression and tried to commit suicide two times prior to 01.10.2013.
The cancellation report was filed in the court and after issuance of the notice of the Cancellation Report by the court, Om Prakash Yadav, father of the deceased appeared in the court.

His statement was recorded and the Cancellation Report was accepted by the court of ld. MM vide order dated 16.11.2021 and aggrieved against the said impugned order dated 16.11.2021 passed by the court of Ld. MM, North District, Rohini Courts,
Delhi, the instant revision petition has been filed by the revisionist who is uncle of the deceased on the grounds that :-
a) That, the impugned order has been passed without the application of judicial mind and appreciation of the facts of circumstances/evidence of the instant case.
b) That, the ld. MM has failed to appreciate that the cancellation report shall only be accepted by the Presiding Officer only after properly analyzing the facts of the case,
however, ld. MM accepted the cancellation report merely upon the statement/acceptance of the complainant which was given under coercion and undue influence.
c) That, the ld. MM failed to take into consideration the fact that the letters made by the complainant and the brother of the deceased to the IO amounting to which cancellation report was prepared by the IO seems to be bogus and illogical.

sentences.text: MM may kindly be set aside.
4. That, the notice of the revision petition was served upon the State and ld.
APP for the State has submitted that he does not want to file the reply of the revision petition and has argued straightaway.

It is submitted by ld. APP for the State that the revisionist who is the uncle of the deceased has no right to file the revision petition on the ground that the statement of Om Prakash Yadav, father of the deceased has also been recorded by the ld.
Trial court at the time of accepting the Cancellation Report being filed by the SHO concerned and make a submission that the revision petition may kindly be dismissed.
5. Having heard the submissions made by Ld. counsel for the revisionist as well as ld. APP for the State and after gone through the impugned order dated 16.11.2021 passed by the ld.
Trial court as well as the trial court record

, this court is of the considered view that the investigation in case FIR No.535/2013 u/s 498A/306/34 IPC PS Samaypur Badli was registered on a written complaint made by Sh. Om Prakash, father of the deceased stated therein that Manju Yadav who was his daughter and she was married with Prem Kumar in the year 1997.

He had given the dowry as per his capacity but after some time, the said Prem Kumar, husband of his daughter and his family members started to harass his daughter for demand of dowry and because of the harassment alleged to have been caused by her husband and her in-laws, her daughter committed suicide on 01.10.2013.

He did not give any statement to the police on the alleged day of the incident i.e. 01.10.2013 and stated that he will give statement at later stage and made a request that the Postmortem of Manju Yadav may kindly be carried out by the Board of Doctors.

His request was considered and the postmortem of his daughter namely Manju Yadav was carried out by the Board of Doctors and who has opined that the "Death is occurred due to asphyxia as a result of hanging via ligature mark.
The ligature mark is antemortem in nature, fresh prior to death in duration and is caused by ligature material.
6. That, on dated 12.10.2013, a written complaint was made by Sh. Om Prakash, father of the deceased alleged that her daughter was killed by her husband Prem Kumar and his family members.

Investigation was carried out and during the course of the investigation, the IO has received a letter in the Police Station sent through Post carrying a suicide note dated 05.10.2013 and the said suicide note was written in language 'Hindi' and signature of the deceased in Hindi also there in the end of the suicide note.

The said suicide note was sent for FSL result with specimen signature of the deceased and the report of the FSL has been received and in the report of handwriting expert, it is mentioned "Exhibit question red and blue signatures Mark- Q1 purported to be suicide note written by Deceased Manju Yadav red enclosed standard signature A1 to A4 Deceased Manju Yadav.
The red enclosed Question Marked Q1 executed in the year 2013, whether the admit signature Mark A1 to A4 executed in the year 2000.
There is gap of approx. 13 years between the Q and the standard signatures.
As such, it has not been possible to express any opinion."

sentences.text: It has also been opined by handwriting expert that in the absence of contemporary signature of the person concerned and after making sincere efforts, the signature on the suicide note could not be matched.

7. That, during the course of the investigation, the father of the deceased namely Om Prakash and his brother handed over a letter to the IO stated therein that because of some misunderstanding, he had made a complaint to the Police.
His daughter was patient of depression and he has no grievance against husband of his daughter and his family members.
On these grounds, the Cancellation Report was filed before the court of ld. MM, North District, Rohini Courts, Delhi on 16.12.2020.

entities.text: MM, North District, Rohini Courts, Delhi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
After gone through the Cancellation Report being filed by the IO, a notice was issued to the complainant namely Om Prakash, father of the deceased and his statement was recorded on 16.11.2021 before the court of ld. MM, North District, Rohini Courts and the statement of namely Om Prakash Yadav,
father of the deceased is as under :-

entities.text: court of ld. MM, North District, Rohini Courts
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: "I am the complainant in the present case.
I am satisfied with the investigation carried out by the Investigating Officer.
I have no objection if Cancellation Report filed by the IO is accepted.
I do not wish to file Protest Petition.
I am making my statement voluntarily."

On this statement, the Cancellation Report being filed by the IO was accepted by the court of ld.
MM, North District.
8.

entities.text:
court of ld.
MM, North District
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: That, the instant revision petition has been filed namely Dhanveer Singh who is the uncle of the deceased.

Since the statement was made by the father of the deceased who was the complainant in the case FIR No.535/2013 u/s 498A/306/34 IPC PS Samaypur Badli and in his statement, he had stated that he has no objection if the court accept the cancellation report and he is also not willing to file any protest petition.
His statement was recorded before the court of ld. MM volunatarily and without any pressure or coercion.

9. It is pertinent to mention that the revisionist Dhanveer Singh was neither the complainant nor was summoned by the Court of ld. MM and he had only identified the dead body of the deceased with the real brother of the deceased and therefore, this court is of the considered view that the revisionist Dhanveer Singh has no locus strandi to file the revision petition.
Hence, the same is hereby dismissed.
10. TCR be sent back to the ld.
Trial court
with copy of this order

. 
11. File be consigned to record room.
